body:
OpenAI says over 100,000 advertisers have used ChatGPT Ads, now expanding to 26 more countries. ("ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform," OpenAI, 21 Oct 2026, https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-ads-expands-26-new-countries)

Most people reading that headline will think "new place to run ads." That's the least useful part of it.

The useful part is in a second post from the same day: how OpenAI built the ad stack itself, meaning how it decides which ad you see and why. ("How we built ChatGPT's novel ad stack for user trust and relevance," OpenAI, 21 Oct 2026, https://openai.com/index/building-chatgpt-ad-stack)

Every platform you've ever run ads on — Meta, Google, now this — is built the same way underneath. It has a goal you set, a signal it learns from, and a cost it charges when it misreads you.

On Meta, that goal lives in Ads Manager, inside your ad set, on the line called Performance goal. Most accounts I've looked at have it set wrong for what they actually want.

A new ad platform arriving doesn't change that. It just means there will soon be one more goal line to get wrong, in one more place.

The question worth asking before you touch ChatGPT Ads isn't "should I try this." It's whether you already know what your current platform's goal line is set to.

If you want to send me a screenshot of that line, I'll tell you plainly if it's doing what you think it's doing.

slides.label: ADVERTISERS ALREADY IN
slides.text: OpenAI says over 100,000 advertisers have used ChatGPT Ads, now live in 26 more countries.
A new place to spend money is not the news. What decides your result is.
Every ad platform runs on the same three things: a goal you set, a signal it learns from, a cost for getting it wrong.
OpenAI just published how its ad stack decides what you see — not just that ads exist, but how they're chosen.
On Meta, that goal lives in one place: Ads Manager, your ad set, the line called Performance goal.
Most people never open that line after campaign setup. It sits there, quietly deciding who you pay for.

slides.left: Goal chosen at launch, never revisited
slides.right: Goal matched to what you actually need now
slides.text: The leak isn't the new platform. It's the old goal nobody rechecked.
A new platform arriving just means one more goal line, in one more place, someone will forget to check.

slides.label: THE HABIT
slides.text: Before trying ChatGPT Ads or anything new, open your current one and read that line first.
The platform changes every year. The habit of checking what you told it to optimise for doesn't.
